title: Personal Sender Account Terms — Appealing a Suspension
content:
**Clause.** An appeal of a suspension of a Personal Sender Account is the customer's own claim, lodged by the customer and never by an agent on their behalf. An appeal is accepted only while the account status is suspended. An appeal may be lodged only within the level's appeal window in calendar days after the suspension took effect. The window is counted in calendar days from the date the suspension took effect, and an appeal lodged on that date plus the window days is still on time. Only one appeal is accepted per suspension.

## Decision on the appeal

| Outcome | Effect |
|---|---|
| Upheld | The account is reinstated to active at its existing level, with any open request for information still to be answered. |
| Refused | The account is terminated. |
| No appeal within the window | The account is terminated. |

Transfers held while the account was suspended are refunded under the refund rules of their delivery method if the account is terminated.

## Conditions at a glance

1. The account status is suspended.
2. The appeal is lodged no later than the suspension date plus the appeal window.
3. No appeal has already been lodged for this suspension.
4. The customer lodges it personally.

## Boundary (hypothetical dates, 30-day window)

An account suspended on 2 March can be appealed up to and including 1 April (2 March plus 30 days). An appeal on 2 April is out of time.
